[FACT] User is a product designer at LottieFiles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Introduction to the webinar includes a welcome message and the speaker's name placeholder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The webinar will discuss how to bring digital products to life with motion and Lottie animations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The target audience for the webinar includes designers, developers, and marketers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Motion design is defined as the art of creating movement and animation in digital products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lottie animations are described as lightweight animations that can be integrated into mobile apps, websites, and other digital products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lottie animations are based on JSON data and can be easily exported and imported into different platforms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Benefits of using motion and Lottie animations include improved user engagement and retention, making products more interactive, and conveying information effectively.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Micro-interactions are defined as small animations providing feedback to users, with examples including button hover states, loading animations, and error messages.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Storytelling animations are described as animations used to tell a story or convey a message in a digital product.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The process of creating Lottie animations involves using Adobe After Effects, exporting as a JSON file, and importing into a digital product using the Lottie library.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Lottie library allows for easy control of animations, including playing, pausing, and looping.
